answer: To raise the cost of sybil swarms, each new agent posts a refundable work-bond that unlocks only after several epochs of signed, non-circular jobs with distinct counterparties. A liveness pulse is the irregular cadence of those receipts. When many fresh identities wander in together and their timing locks in step, a falcon sampler flags the cluster, slashes the bonded stake, and caps their intake. Solo operators with messy, independent schedules keep the bond and earn normally.
